contracts.name: Reducer contract
contracts.description: transition(graph, state, input, now) and pure reconcile(graph, state, facts, now); commands and observations with idempotency keys; effects with effect_key; ScopeKey; session_generation; slot closing and post_close_activity; StartRun(from_node); closed pause reasons with resume-condition kinds; error taxonomy; I1-I8; state_version with N-reads-N-1. Additive after IM-0 (ENG-01 ledgers each): cause infra.runner_lost; drift causes session_archived, session_deleted, anchor_archived, anchor_deleted, session_stopped, policy_missing and bundle_changed; paused_until on paused(plan_limit), set to resets_at + 60 s from HRN-04's S24 signal, at which ENG-06's plan-limit timer fires. Activation sub-state merge_conflict{files, resolver_slot} (WSP-03 opens it; TLS-04's coral_assign_task is allowed in it). Run fields checkpoint_sha and sandbox_generation (WSP-04). Slot fields: evaluating lease (lease_holder, lease_expires_at; X-15), hold_seen_at, restart_attempt_id, last_edge_status, last_turn_outcome, last_edge_at. contracts.description: Closed additive kind enum, seq, actor, scope key, 16 KiB body cap, refs, idempotency key, a RunView patch per entry, log_version; fold(log) == state. Kinds are dotted <noun>.<event> with snake_case segments (arrow.skipped, loop.limit_reached).
